Table S2. Signs of cross peaks in synchronous and asynchronous (in parentheses) 2D correlation spectra (2D-COS) under different stirring speeds.

Note. “+” and “−” indicate positive and negative cross peaks, respectively. The signs outside parentheses represent synchronous correlation peaks, whereas those inside parentheses represent asynchronous correlation peaks. According to Noda’s rules, for a cross peak at (ν₁, ν₂), if the synchronous and asynchronous signs are the same, the functional group at ν₁ responds earlier than that at ν₂. If the signs are opposite, the functional group at ν₂ responds earlier than that at ν₁.
